title: AI/ML Engineer Intern
shortDescription: Build, benchmark, and deploy enterprise Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, multimodal vision systems, and autonomous agent networks alongside senior architects.
description: We are seeking a driven, intellectually curious AI/ML Engineer Intern to join DeepLayer Solutions' core intelligence team. In this role, you will contribute directly to production-grade AI pipelines, fine-tune modern foundation models (Gemini 2.5, Claude, GPT-4o, and open-weights LLaMA 3), optimize low-latency RAG architectures using vector databases, and deploy scalable microservices that serve real client workloads.
responsibilities: Design, benchmark, and optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures using hybrid dense-sparse search (Qdrant, BM25, and Text-Embedding-004).
Assist in fine-tuning, evaluating, and quantizing modern open-source LLMs and Vision-Language Models (VLMs) using PyTorch, Hugging Face, and vLLM.
Implement structured data extraction, document parsing, and layout-aware chunking for complex enterprise PDFs, tables, and multimodal datasets.
Develop, containerize, and deploy high-throughput asynchronous inference microservices using FastAPI, Docker, and Redis caching.
Implement rigorous evaluation matrices (faithfulness, hallucination detection, context recall, and latency telemetry) using automated test suites.
Collaborate in daily engineering scrums, peer code reviews, and architectural design discussions following clean production standards.
requirements: Enrolled in or graduate of a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI, Data Science, or related STEM discipline.
Strong proficiency in Python 3.10+ and core numerical packages (NumPy, Pandas, SciPy).
Hands-on experience with modern machine learning frameworks (PyTorch, Scikit-learn, Hugging Face Transformers).
Solid understanding of fundamental AI concepts: Attention mechanisms, embeddings, vector indexing, loss functions, and optimization algorithms.
Experience with RESTful API development using Python frameworks (FastAPI or Flask) and containerization with Docker.
Proficiency with Git, GitHub version control, branch management, and collaborative development.
Strong analytical problem-solving mindset with the ability to read and implement modern research papers into working code.
preferredQualifications: Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or autonomous agent frameworks.
Familiarity with vector databases (Qdrant, Pinecone, Milvus, or Chroma).
Prior experience deploying machine learning services to cloud infrastructure (AWS EC2/S3, GCP, or RunPod).
Contributions to open-source machine learning repositories or participation in Kaggle / competitive hackathons.
perks: 100% Remote Flexibility & Asynchronous Work Culture
Competitive Monthly Paid Stipend + Fast-Track Full-Time Placement
Direct 1-on-1 Mentorship from Principal AI Architects & Machine Learning Leads
Hands-On Experience Shipping Real Enterprise Production AI Systems

Optimize frontend client performance, bundle sizes, image delivery, and Core Web Vitals across desktop and mobile devices.
Integrate third-party services, payment gateways, authentication flows (OAuth / Supabase Auth), and asynchronous email systems.
Write unit and integration tests, participate in daily code reviews, and ship features continuously via automated CI/CD pipelines.
requirements: Enrolled in or graduate of a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related technical field.

Hands-on experience building web applications using React (hooks, component lifecycle, state management) and Next.js.

Understanding of relational database fundamentals (PostgreSQL or MySQL) and RESTful API architectures.
Familiarity with Git, GitHub pull request workflows, and collaborative software engineering practices.
Strong passion for writing clean, readable, maintainable, and well-documented code.
